web-guide-idea-97.audience: NRI families wanting an accessible cultural activity together.
web-guide-idea-97.offer: Lead a guardian-managed session on one festival, story or tradition. Make room for different family practices rather than presenting one version as universal.
web-guide-idea-97.steps.0: Send a simple family preparation note.
web-guide-idea-97.steps.1: Tell the story and demonstrate an activity.
web-guide-idea-97.steps.2: Invite questions and suggest something families can continue at home.
web-guide-idea-97.equipment: A phone and the simple materials for the selected activity. Guardians oversee children’s participation.
web-guide-idea-97.returnReason: Create a calendar across seasons and regions, with a different focus each Sunday.
web-guide-idea-97.promotion: Name the topic, age suitability and guardian role clearly.

web-guide-idea-97.metadataDescription: Explore a festival, story, recipe or tradition through a guardian-managed family session. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
